LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.description: A foreign flame fastened to the target's life. It drains needs and age, weakens combat and work, deals true burning damage, and gives nearby enemies 10% of their own burst threshold when the host dies.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.description: Self Burn bonuses apply once per complete 10 layers, up to 300 layers. Each 10 layers grants +4% melee and skill damage, +0.8% ranged damage, +2% movement, and +4% attack and work speed. Above 300 layers, Overburn doubles direct damage and Life Burn output and drains the flame reserve. Every 10 seconds, all excess layers are consumed in a radius-5 explosion centered on Mingyuan, dealing 1 damage per layer. Nearby allies and buildings can be hit; Mingyuan is excluded.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.description: A body remade by pale fire. Consciousness rises; heat and explosions restore the body, attackers are burned in return, control states are cleared, and each wound grants 5 Self Burn and 0.2 seconds of invulnerability. This passive does not reduce ordinary incoming damage.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.label: <color=#FFE0A3>Protective Flame Shield</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.descri: A 100-point pale flame reserve. Every 10 seconds, 1 point restores one missing body part or heals all wounds and scars on one part. Stable Self Burn can replenish the reserve; Overburn drains it. The reserve does not absorb damage.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Rebirth Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.description: When Mingyuan falls, the flame buried in her body detonates, leaves a rebirth flame, and restores her after 30 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.label: <color=#FF2E1F>Eternal Burning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.description: Mingyuan is enclosed in the fire that rebuilds her. While this flame lasts, outside blows cannot decide her death.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.description: The target's lifetime is being burned away. When the remaining biological age reaches zero, the flame claims the body.
